# Status and known limitations

- **The frame checker is heuristic.** Expect occasional misfires on unusual syntax. Every one is visible in
  [explain mode](explain.md), and most are fixed by tightenin' a trigger pattern in the data rather than the
  code. Now, the hand\-written frame checker now uses a small bundled POS model for noun/verb context;
  [DD-016](../architecture/decisions/dd-016-reconcile-source-capabilities.md) records its offline boundary.
  Dependent result constructions \(`so … that`, `too … to`, `… enough to`) retain their operators and
  conservatively admit single\-word predicate forms. Recognised coordinated predicates share that
  restriction. Comma\-stacked synonyms require established following context; a relative\-clause
  continuation, punctuation alone or hidden markup doesn't establish room for a stack.
  With an original, lint/verify flag a recognised predicate expansion before the source's unchanged
  `enough` tail when the surrounding sentence provides one unambiguous local pairing. They abstain
  without that evidence; this check doesn't establish grammatical correctness for arbitrary retellings.
- **The built-in API client has not been run against the live API.** Tagging, `--surface`, `--rewrite` and yarn mode
  are tested with fake clients. The yarn workflow itself has been exercised by agents through its research CLI
  (`research/retellings-2026-10-11/yarn_tools.py`), which shares yarn mode's brief and tools.
- **The seed listicle is discovery evidence, not dictionary authority.** It was acquired'n reviewed on
  2026\-10\-17: 212 normalised candidates yielded ten additions, existin' component coverage'n explicit
  non\-promotion decisions. Mate, some creative comparisons remain conditional craft rather than executable
  meanings. See [the decisions](../../research/maintenance-2026-10-17/seed-decisions.yaml) and
  [data acquisition](../contributor/data-acquisition.md).
- **Waltzing Matilda still needs exact edition verification.** Its lyrics haven't been compared with an
  accessible scan of Cowan's 1903 sheet music. Well, the Gettysburg fixture was checked on 2026\-10\-15 against the
  [Library of Congress's standard Lincoln Memorial transcription](https://www.loc.gov/exhibits/gettysburg-address/ext/trans-nicolay-inscribed.html):
  wording matches after documented punctuation/case'n word\-joining normalisation. The fixture's existin'
  typography is retained; see `tests/corpus/reference/SOURCES.yaml`.
- **Fidelity'n lookup remain heuristic.** Explicit name aliases avoid inferrin' replacements inside proper
  names, but sentence\-initial names can still escape extraction. Slot/inflection matching'n negation anchors
  fix the reproduced toolkit cases; they don't solve general negation or sense disambiguation. Review
  suggestions in their actual sentence; recognised source guards cover reviewed meanings, not all wording.
- **Mechanical acceptance doesn't establish retelling quality.** The first fresh 20\-text blind comparison
  scored meaning 4.95/5 but register 2.00/5: eligible prose was too restrained. All deterministic checks
  passed. Anyway, a further writer revision under contract\-aware evaluation scored meaning 4.95/5 and register
  4.65/5, with some high\-level prose still too light'n a minor forecast narrowin'. Fair dinkum, the packet protocol
  and judges changed; those rounds don't establish a causal engine improvement. See
  [the findings](../../research/document-refinement-2026-10-15/FINDINGS.md) for raw results'n limits.
- **The bundled embeddin' model can lag later dictionary corrections.** Model 1.3.0 remains bundled and
  passes all 33 frozen required checks, but its dictionary fingerprint is stale. The fresh 2026\-10\-20
  evaluation/full\-data trial passed 29/33 and 30/33 respectively; the full candidate missed `girl`, `feeling
  really down` and `a good mate of mine`. It was rejected before release export. Well, a separate diagnostic reader
  reproduced those outcomes'n wasn't adopted. See the
  [trial and benchmark evidence](../../research/semantic-followup-2026-10-20/README.md). Current lookup's
  bounded source guards don't establish general model relevance. Default automatic gap fillin' stays off.
- **Conservative source corrections trade coverage for supported meaning.** General work/activity versus
  artwork or childbirth isn't resolved automatically; yakka remains discoverable'n available for
  explicit hard yakka. Unqualified asylum, den'n ice box don't establish psychiatric/domestic/portable
  senses. Percy supports intransitive clause endings'n supported adverbial tails, retaining other
  complements as written. Coordinated or ambiguous progressive objects can remain plain.
- **Degree'n quantity checking cover reviewed families and mappings.** DRUNK and HUNGRY have reviewed
  source/target degree calibration; unknown ratings aren't inferred from style intensity. Well, quantity approximation is explicit
  and preset\-controlled, with bounded source/output checks. Bloody hell, local original\-aware checks catch known
  incompatible grades, with ambiguity'n simultaneous edits limiting coverage. It isn't general fact checking.

- **Lookup is bounded meaning discovery.** Recognised heads, external polarity'n reviewed degree can
  constrain lexical'n model suggestions together. Struth, unknown modifiers, subordinators and unsupported
  structure retain broader fallback; direct term discovery doesn't certify an in\-place replacement.
  Anyway, figurative senses without corpus restrictions'n unsupported\-query model errors remain possible.
